function.name: get_datetime
function.description: Get the current date and time for the user. Never guess the time. For a simple greeting (hi, hello, hey), call with query=greeting to get timezone, date, local time, and time-of-day. For calendars, schedules, or exact clock questions, call with query=full.

query.description: What to return: greeting, timezone, date, time, weekday, or full. Default greeting.

timezone.description: IANA timezone such as Africa/Lagos. Omit to infer from the user's phone number.
